snippet.title: RESIDENT EVIL Gamecube REMAKE – Chris Redfield FULL GAME Walkthrough - ALL ENDINGS 100% Collectibles
snippet.description:
Welcome to this new walkthrough series, featuring the original Gamecube remake of the horror classic “Resident Evil”. This Chris Redfield walkthrough guide features all the four possible endings, achieving a 100% lore recollection of the saga's first entry. Enjoy :)

RESIDENT EVIL ORIGINS COLLECTION: https://youtu.be/gH1rMWB2uU0

RESIDENT EVIL THE DARKSIDE CHRONICLES Full Game: https://youtu.be/MM9z1bePAKA?si=Sa8HK0TjD8YLdZlb

RESIDENT EVIL THE UMBRELLA CHRONICLES Full Game: https://youtu.be/k4CxdCGQlns?si=SlLgeQR97Ge_sNPz

RESIDENT EVIL 2 ORIGINAL N64 PORT https://youtu.be/j0Qz2Z-9pSM

RESIDENT EVIL 3 NEMESIS GameCube REMAKE: https://youtu.be/_eqD5t8vBng

RESIDENT EVIL 4 REMAKE Full Game: https://youtu.be/XSHyHBLbAU8
